I stopped round 192 before changing any code. The task says to stop and report if the brass-text check finds sites beyond B's four, and it found four more. The store tree is unchanged at `caa09af`.

**Start checks:** all passed. HEAD is `caa09af`, the frozen list (1017 entries) checks OK, and all five granted files match their start hashes.

**Studio safety of the new token values:** this part is clear, and the evidence can be reused after a re-grant.
- Eight store tokens are not overridden by the Studio's obsidian block. Only one of them is used in code the Studio renders: `text-secondary` at `Toast.tsx:82`. Toasts appear only after adding or removing a cart item, which can't happen in `/studio-lab`.
- The 29 `app.css` rules that use these tokens belong to 22 selectors. None of those class names appears in Studio code.
- No CSS custom property is computed from the colour tokens at the page root, and `html` has no background. So nothing would leak into the Studio from there.

**The blocker:** these sites put light text on a brass, buy or destructive fill but are not in the grants. Each row shows the ratio now → after the token change → with the dark `text-brand-foreground`:

| Site | What it is | Now | After | With dark text |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PurchaseHeader.tsx:348` | Buy Now button on product pages | 4.05 | **1.88** | 8.32 |
| `LeadMagnetPopup.tsx:141` | CONTINUE button in the keep-list "FREE DOWNLOAD" popup | 3.29 | 2.57 | 6.09 |
| `Modal.tsx:307` | Destructive confirm button | 3.29 | 2.57 | 6.09 |
| `ChatButton.tsx:38` | Unread badge on the chat button | 3.29 | 2.57 | 6.09 |
| `ForgetPassword.tsx:80` (optional) | Check icon inside a brass circle | 1.55 | 1.88 | 8.32 |

The Buy Now drop is the serious one. `/products/middle-east` is one of C's pages, so C's contrast check would record it as a Medium caused by this round.

**My proposal for B:** extend the round-192 grants to the same one-word change (`text-foreground` → `text-brand-foreground`) at the first four sites, optionally the fifth, and widen the new test's button-class check (ST5) to cover them. The popup is on Saba's keep-list. Changing only its text colour should count as a restyle, but B or root should confirm that.

**Other evidence recorded:**
- The frozen e2e specs contain no old colour values. Their three class assertions in `store-page.spec.ts` don't depend on token values.
- Before any change, `data-studio-theme` appears 3 times in non-test `app/` files (once in `.ts`/`.tsx`), for the "no theme attribute on store markup" check (ST6).

**Not done:** the token values, the four granted class edits, the new test, both docs, the red proof, the browser proof, and typecheck, lint and Biome. With no files changed, there was nothing to give the code reviewer. The advisor call failed because the service was overloaded, so the stop decision follows the task's own rule.
